title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2609.36071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. translated_abstract: 我们提出了 LongCat-DeepResearch，这是一个将增强版 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流相结合的深度研究系统，用于生成全面且有证据支撑的研究报告。该工作流将全局规划与详细调查相分离，并在章节级别协调修订。多个规划智能体首先探索外部资源并完善一份可执行的研究计划（称为 ResearchSpec）。随后，研究智能体并行调查并撰写各自负责的章节，并在分析深入的过程中在独立上下文中收集更多证据。当各章节汇总完成后，全局审查会指导针对性的局部修订，从而减少对反复重写全文的依赖。该工作流还支持构建研究任务和轨迹数据，用于 LongCat 通用模型的中期训练和后训练。LongCat-DeepResearch 在 DeepResearchBench 上达到 55.25 分，在 DeepResearchBench II 上达到 51.35 分……
tldr: LongCat-DeepResearch 将增强版 LongCat 模型与“全局规划—并行分章研究—针对性局部修订”的多智能体工作流相结合，生成全面且有证据支撑的研究报告，并在 DeepResearchBench 等基准上取得领先成绩。
en_tdlr: LongCat-DeepResearch combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow of global planning, parallel section-level research, and targeted local revision to produce comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports, achieving leading scores on DeepResearchBench benchmarks.
